name: Benchmarking DNA Sequence Models for Causal Regulatory Variant Prediction in Human Genetics
description: Benchmark for predicting causal regulatory variants in human genetics from DNA sequences. It compares supervised sequence-to-function models and self-supervised DNA language models on curated regulatory variant labels across Mendelian and complex traits.
evaluation_method: classification and ranking metrics such as AUROC, AUPRC, and correlation/calibration on held-out regulatory variants
notes: Centers on the TraitGym curated dataset of regulatory variants known to be causal or strong candidates across many traits. The benchmark emphasizes careful curation and consistent evaluation for non-coding variant prediction. Exact number of questions is unknown from the provided metadata. Citations reported: 19.
